title: Amaziah Becomes King and Hires Israeli Mercenaries
description: Amaziah becomes king of Judah at twenty-five years old and does what is right in the Lord's eyes, but not with a whole heart. He executes those who killed his father, yet spares their children as the Law of Moses commands. To wage war, he musters 300,000 men from Judah and hires an additional 100,000 warriors from Israel for one hundred talents of silver. A man of God warns him that the Lord is not with Israel, and that he will fall if he takes them along. When Amaziah asks about the lost money, the prophet replies that the Lord can give far more. Amaziah sends the troops home, and they return in anger to Ephraim.
